name: Chthonic-Monolith
description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against massive canyon systems, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.

There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure. Remnant spores persist in sheltered niches, a biosphere's last stubborn embers, awaiting conditions that may never return.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
